description:
FILED s449/s450 (Fable, round-8 batch legs).  The MECHANISM is pre-existing -- leaky-magic.t rows 67-70 ($foo::< $foo::> $foo::( $foo::)) have failed on it all along -- and #561's %! added a new member, flipping row 48 (`ok scalar keys %{"foo::!"} == 0`) from pass to fail: snapshot 66/5 -> 65/6.

DIAGNOSIS (code-read s449, cl/pcl-runtime.lisp):
  %p-symref-symbol builds the package (make-package :use (:cl :pcl)) and asks find-symbol.  For a QUALIFIED name into a foreign package -- "foo::!" -- find-symbol "%!" in |FOO| answers the pcl-EXPORTED |%!| with status :INHERITED, so %p-symref-hash returns MAIN's errno table.  perl: foo's ! glob has no hash; keys = 0.
  The SCALAR twin leaks the same way but only once the package EXISTS (the read path passes create=nil, so a missing package accidentally answers undef -- probed: ${"foo::!"} alone is undef-correct, but would leak after anything creates |FOO|).

BOUNDED: the only sigil-named pcl exports are the punct/caret/magic set (a few dozen; grep '#:|[$@%]' -- NO word-named variables, so @{"foo::ISA"} and user names are unaffected).

FIX SHAPE (ruled s449, one resolver -- rule 11): in %p-symref-symbol, when the name was EXPLICITLY QUALIFIED to a package other than main, a find-symbol answer with status :INHERITED counts as NOT FOUND (read path), and the create path interns a package-LOCAL shadowing symbol (cl:shadow then intern) so writes land in the named package.  The main-qualified spelling (${"main::!"}) and the unqualified spelling must keep finding the magic (probe both before and after).  Also probe the eleven OTHER leaky-magic rows and the four writers (%p-symref-scalar-set / -array / -hash / -box setf) -- they share the resolver, so one change covers all, which is also the risk: run the four-population emission A/B + the full sweep + the op/ leg.

BAR: leaky-magic.t 65/6 -> at least 67/4 (rows 48 + 67-70 are the same mechanism; measure how many flip); the ${"main::!"} + unqualified inverses; a foreign-package WRITE probe (%{"foo::!"} = (a=>1) must not touch main's %!); sweep + op/ leg.

DONE s451w (commit d67d6d0).  %p-symref-symbol treats an :INHERITED answer as NOT FOUND for a name explicitly qualified into a package other than main; the create path cl:shadows before interning (%p-symref-foreign-p / -find / -intern, one resolver, all five call sites).  op/leaky-magic.t 65/6 -> 70/1 (rows 48 + 67-70 flip, plus the SYMBOLIC %{"foo::SIG"} twin), parallel = serial.  12 specials probed vs perl before and after: every foo::-qualified spelling separate, every main::-qualified one shared.  It also stopped %{"foo::ENV"} from destroying the process environment.  Guard Pl/t/symref-package-01.t 6 -> 9 rows; ir-spec 7.1.  cl/-only, no generation bump.  RESIDUE: #700 (the LITERAL %foo::SIG reaches the inherited symbol through the CL READER, not this resolver -- the ONE leaky-magic row left, an emission-side fix), #701 (%{"main::ENV"} replaces the %ENV-MARKER% binding with an empty hash, PRE-EXISTING).
subject: An explicitly-qualified symbolic ref to a MAGIC name resolves to the pcl-EXPORTED symbol inherited into the foreign package -- %{"foo::!"} answers main's 134-key errno table where perl answers the empty foo::! (leaky-magic.t row 48, REGRESSED-into-view by #561)
